title: Casa sobre el Arroyo
description: A house elevated above a natural stream, connecting architecture and landscape through a reinforced concrete structure.

title: Villa Savoye
description: A modernist residence organized around pilotis, free plan, horizontal windows and a roof garden.

title: Farnsworth House
description: A transparent glass house reduced to a precise structural frame and an open relationship with the surrounding landscape.

title: Salk Institute
description: A research center organized around a monumental courtyard that frames the Pacific Ocean.

title: Fallingwater
description: A house composed of horizontal concrete terraces that extend above a natural waterfall and integrate architecture with the landscape.

title: Barcelona Pavilion
description: A pavilion exploring open space, geometric planes, luxurious materials and a continuous relationship between interior and exterior.

title: Glass House
description: A minimalist glass residence defined by transparency, a simple structural frame and a strong connection to its landscape.

title: Maison de Verre
description: An innovative modernist house combining translucent glass blocks, exposed structure and flexible interior elements.

title: Unité d'Habitation
description: A large residential building conceived as a vertical city with apartments, collective facilities and communal spaces.
